verdict.rationale: Calendly's developer docs describe an Embed API for adding a booking page to your own site. They say you can initialize 'one of three embed types' using a scheduling_url, and they give a concrete inline snippet: `Calendly.initInlineWidget({url: myLink})`. missing for 10: explicit naming and snippets for the popup and floating-widget variants in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the embeds working.
